title: 高速鐵路軌道超高配置~Cant design for high-speed railway curves
focus: 曲線超高不足與混合速度的取捨~Cant deficiency and mixed-speed trade-offs
summary: 高速鐵路軌道超高配置以「曲線超高不足與混合速度的取捨」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。超高把軌道平面旋轉以分擔曲線橫向作用，固定超高只能對特定速度平衡；快慢列車共享軌道時，需同時辨認超高不足與超高過剩。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops cant deficiency and mixed-speed trade-offs through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Cant rotates the track plane to balance part of the lateral action on a curve; fixed cant balances only a particular speed, so shared tracks require both deficiency and excess to be examined. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把高速鐵路軌道超高配置放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。超高把軌道平面旋轉以分擔曲線橫向作用，固定超高只能對特定速度平衡；快慢列車共享軌道時，需同時辨認超高不足與超高過剩。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Cant design for high-speed railway curves in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Cant rotates the track plane to balance part of the lateral action on a curve; fixed cant balances only a particular speed, so shared tracks require both deficiency and excess to be examined. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：G=1.5 m, v=70 m/s, R=6000 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=G*v**2/(g*R)*1000=124.873 mm。只把 G 增加百分之十，y=137.36 mm。模型邊界：小傾角剛體平衡且使用指定有效軌距；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：eq=165 mm, actual=125 mm；y=eq-actual=40 mm。只把 eq 增加百分之十，y=56.5 mm。模型邊界：平衡超高與實際超高採同一有效軌距；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: G=1.5 m, v=70 m/s, R=6000 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=G*v**2/(g*R)*1000=124.873 mm. Increasing only G with a ten-percent increase gives y=137.36 mm. Boundary: Small-angle rigid-body balance using the stated effective gauge; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: eq=165 mm, actual=125 mm; y=eq-actual=40 mm. Increasing only eq with a ten-percent increase gives y=56.5 mm. Boundary: Equilibrium and actual cant use the same effective gauge; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 平衡超高計算~Equilibrium cant calculation
units.title: 平衡超高計算~Equilibrium cant calculation
units.mechanism: 平衡超高由向心需求和重力分量匹配求得，所用軌距應明確定義。本模型把 G 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 137.36 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小傾角剛體平衡且使用指定有效軌距。使用有效軌距與曲線半徑作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；代入名義軌距卻沿用另一公式係數會產生系統差異，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Equilibrium cant matches centripetal demand with a gravity component, using an explicitly defined effective gauge. In this model, G is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 137.36 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Small-angle rigid-body balance using the stated effective gauge. Use effective gauge and curve radius as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing nominal gauge with a coefficient based on another gauge causes systematic error; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：G=1.5 m, v=70 m/s, R=6000 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=G*v**2/(g*R)*1000=124.873 mm。只把 G 增加百分之十，y=137.36 mm。模型邊界：小傾角剛體平衡且使用指定有效軌距；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: G=1.5 m, v=70 m/s, R=6000 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=G*v**2/(g*R)*1000=124.873 mm. Increasing only G with a ten-percent increase gives y=137.36 mm. Boundary: Small-angle rigid-body balance using the stated effective gauge; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以有效軌距與曲線半徑區分模型與觀察，先用超高尺、半徑與同步速度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「平衡超高計算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use effective gauge and curve radius to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using cant level, radius and synchronized speed record, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Equilibrium cant calculation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 代入名義軌距卻沿用另一公式係數會產生系統差異。這個失效與「平衡超高計算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查有效軌距與曲線半徑，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Mixing nominal gauge with a coefficient based on another gauge causes systematic error. This failure and a measurement bias in Equilibrium cant calculation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check effective gauge and curve radius rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：代入名義軌距卻沿用另一公式係數會產生系統差異~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixing nominal gauge with a coefficient based on another gauge causes systematic error.
units.practice: 重算「平衡超高計算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出小傾角剛體平衡且使用指定有效軌距如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由代入名義軌距卻沿用另一公式係數會產生系統差異造成偏離的合成觀察，以有效軌距與曲線半徑說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Equilibrium cant calculation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Small-angle rigid-body balance using the stated effective gauge. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Mixing nominal gauge with a coefficient based on another gauge causes systematic error. Explain which evidence in effective gauge and curve radius distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 超高不足辨認~Cant-deficiency calculation
units.mechanism: 平衡需求高於實際超高時留下向外未平衡作用。本模型把 eq 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 56.5 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。平衡超高與實際超高採同一有效軌距。使用速度分組後的平衡需求作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只看安裝超高會漏掉高速通過的未平衡作用，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~A balance requirement greater than installed cant leaves an outward unbalanced action. In this model, eq is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 56.5 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equilibrium and actual cant use the same effective gauge. Use equilibrium demand grouped by speed as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Installed cant alone misses the unbalanced action of fast passages; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：eq=165 mm, actual=125 mm；y=eq-actual=40 mm。只把 eq 增加百分之十，y=56.5 mm。模型邊界：平衡超高與實際超高採同一有效軌距；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: eq=165 mm, actual=125 mm; y=eq-actual=40 mm. Increasing only eq with a ten-percent increase gives y=56.5 mm. Boundary: Equilibrium and actual cant use the same effective gauge; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以速度分組後的平衡需求區分模型與觀察，先用同里程速度群與超高剖面建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「超高不足辨認」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use equilibrium demand grouped by speed to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using speed groups and cant profiles at matching chainage, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Cant-deficiency calculation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只看安裝超高會漏掉高速通過的未平衡作用。這個失效與「超高不足辨認」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查速度分組後的平衡需求，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Installed cant alone misses the unbalanced action of fast passages. This failure and a measurement bias in Cant-deficiency calculation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check equilibrium demand grouped by speed rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只看安裝超高會漏掉高速通過的未平衡作用~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Installed cant alone misses the unbalanced action of fast passages.
units.practice: 重算「超高不足辨認」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出平衡超高與實際超高採同一有效軌距如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只看安裝超高會漏掉高速通過的未平衡作用造成偏離的合成觀察，以速度分組後的平衡需求說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Cant-deficiency calculation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Equilibrium and actual cant use the same effective gauge. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Installed cant alone misses the unbalanced action of fast passages. Explain which evidence in equilibrium demand grouped by speed distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 超高過剩辨認~Cant-excess calculation
units.mechanism: 慢車平衡需求較小，軌道傾斜可能使重力分量主導向內作用。本模型把 actual 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 92.5 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。低速平衡超高已獨立算得，不含車體懸吊。使用低速或停車時的傾斜量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把較大超高視為所有列車都有利會忽略慢車負擔，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~A slow train has a smaller balance requirement, allowing the inward gravity component to dominate. In this model, actual is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 92.5 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Low-speed equilibrium cant is independently calculated; suspension is excluded. Use cant during slow movement or a stop as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Assuming larger cant benefits every train ignores slow-train loading; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：actual=125 mm, eq=45 mm；y=actual-eq=80 mm。只把 actual 增加百分之十，y=92.5 mm。模型邊界：低速平衡超高已獨立算得，不含車體懸吊；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: actual=125 mm, eq=45 mm; y=actual-eq=80 mm. Increasing only actual with a ten-percent increase gives y=92.5 mm. Boundary: Low-speed equilibrium cant is independently calculated; suspension is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以低速或停車時的傾斜量區分模型與觀察，先用低速通過紀錄與超高尺建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「超高過剩辨認」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use cant during slow movement or a stop to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-speed passage records and cant level, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Cant-excess calculation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把較大超高視為所有列車都有利會忽略慢車負擔。這個失效與「超高過剩辨認」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查低速或停車時的傾斜量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Assuming larger cant benefits every train ignores slow-train loading. This failure and a measurement bias in Cant-excess calculation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check cant during slow movement or a stop rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「超高過剩辨認」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出低速平衡超高已獨立算得，不含車體懸吊如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把較大超高視為所有列車都有利會忽略慢車負擔造成偏離的合成觀察，以低速或停車時的傾斜量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Cant-excess calculation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Low-speed equilibrium cant is independently calculated; suspension is excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Assuming larger cant benefits every train ignores slow-train loading. Explain which evidence in cant during slow movement or a stop distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 未平衡橫向加速~Unbalanced lateral acceleration
units.title: 未平衡橫向加速~Unbalanced lateral acceleration
units.mechanism: 超高不足乘重力再除有效軌距可估未平衡橫向加速度。本模型把 g 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.28776 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小傾角近似且超高不足以公尺輸入。使用超高不足與橫向感測值作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；感測器安裝傾角未校正會混入重力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Cant deficiency times gravity divided by effective gauge estimates unbalanced lateral acceleration. In this model, g is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.28776 m/s2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Small-angle approximation with cant deficiency in metres. Use cant deficiency and lateral sensor readings as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Uncorrected sensor roll mixes gravity into the measurement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：g=9.81 m/s2, D=0.04 m, G=1.5 m；y=g*D/G=0.2616 m/s2。只把 g 增加百分之十，y=0.28776 m/s2。模型邊界：小傾角近似且超高不足以公尺輸入；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: g=9.81 m/s2, D=0.04 m, G=1.5 m; y=g*D/G=0.2616 m/s2. Increasing only g with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.28776 m/s2. Boundary: Small-angle approximation with cant deficiency in metres; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以超高不足與橫向感測值區分模型與觀察，先用軌面座標橫向加速度計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「未平衡橫向加速」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use cant deficiency and lateral sensor readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using lateral accelerometer in track-plane coordinates, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Unbalanced lateral acceleration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 感測器安裝傾角未校正會混入重力。這個失效與「未平衡橫向加速」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查超高不足與橫向感測值，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Uncorrected sensor roll mixes gravity into the measurement. This failure and a measurement bias in Unbalanced lateral acceleration can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check cant deficiency and lateral sensor readings rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只使用平均速度會低估平方速度的平均值。這個失效與「混合列車均方速度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各速度群比例與平方速度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Using mean speed alone understates mean squared speed. This failure and a measurement bias in Mixed-traffic squared speed can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check group proportions and squared speeds rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.anchor: 超高量測不確定度~Cant measurement uncertainty
units.title: 超高量測不確定度~Cant measurement uncertainty
units.mechanism: 左右軌高程差的不確定度要保留兩側誤差與相關性。本模型把 ul 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.743303 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。左右軌誤差獨立，未納入共同零點偏差。使用左右軌交換測量的閉合差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；儀器零點漂移可能被誤認為整段超高偏移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Uncertainty in rail-level difference must retain both rail errors and their correlation. In this model, ul is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.743303 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Independent rail errors, excluding common zero bias. Use closure from swapped left-right measurements as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Instrument zero drift can resemble a cant shift along the whole segment; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：ul=0.5 mm, ur=0.5 mm；y=sqrt(ul**2+ur**2)=0.707107 mm。只把 ul 增加百分之十，y=0.743303 mm。模型邊界：左右軌誤差獨立，未納入共同零點偏差；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: ul=0.5 mm, ur=0.5 mm; y=sqrt(ul**2+ur**2)=0.707107 mm. Increasing only ul with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.743303 mm. Boundary: Independent rail errors, excluding common zero bias; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以左右軌交換測量的閉合差區分模型與觀察，先用左右交換的水準尺讀值建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「超高量測不確定度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use closure from swapped left-right measurements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using levelling readings with left-right reversal, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Cant measurement uncertainty. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 儀器零點漂移可能被誤認為整段超高偏移。這個失效與「超高量測不確定度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查左右軌交換測量的閉合差，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Instrument zero drift can resemble a cant shift along the whole segment. This failure and a measurement bias in Cant measurement uncertainty can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check closure from swapped left-right measurements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Instrument zero drift can resemble a cant shift along the whole segment. Explain which evidence in closure from swapped left-right measurements distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
